description: This file defines the SpendUpdateQueue class, which manages an in-memory queue for spend updates, including methods for adding updates, aggregating them, and converting updates into database transactions. It is part of a larger system handling spend update processing and database transaction management.

classes.name: SpendUpdateQueue
classes.description: A class that manages an in-memory queue for spend updates, providing methods to add, aggregate, and convert updates into database transactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SpendUpdateQueue with an asyncio queue.

methods.name: flush_and_get_aggregated_db_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Flushes all updates from the queue and returns aggregated database spend update transactions.

methods.name: add_update
methods.description: Adds a spend update item to the queue and triggers aggregation if the queue is full.

methods.name: aggregate_queue_updates
methods.description: Aggregates all updates in the queue to reduce its size by combining similar updates.

methods.name: _get_aggregated_spend_update_queue_item
methods.description: Aggregates a list of spend update items by entity type and ID, summing response costs.

methods.name: get_aggregated_db_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Converts a list of updates into structured database transaction data grouped by entity type.

methods.name: _emit_new_item_added_to_queue_event
methods.description: Asynchronously emits an event indicating a new item has been added to the queue.
